name: VoxtMini
description: macOS voice input: press a shortcut in any app, speak, and local Qwen3-ASR or Whisper models on MLX type, translate or rewrite the text at your cursor.
compatibility: Speech runs locally with Qwen3-ASR or Whisper on MLX, or with Apple Speech; clean-up, translation and rewriting use local language models such as Qwen3.5 and Hy-MT2.
A remote service (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, DeepSeek and others) or Ollama and LM Studio on the same Mac can be chosen per feature instead of the local default.
limitations: Needs macOS 15 or later on Apple silicon; 16 GB of memory is recommended for the recommended models.
Beta software; models download on first use from Hugging Face.
Needs the Microphone permission, and Accessibility to type into other apps.
No account and no analytics; feedback and diagnostics are sent to actnow.dev only when the user sends them from the feedback window.
